notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Argothian Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Argothian Elder.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Argothian Elder.
Activate two mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping the lands.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Argothian Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Argothian Elder.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Argothian Elder from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.
